_comment: Announced Global release dates for the JP-ahead skills gated by the umas dated in uma_release_overrides.json (P5). Added 2026-08-12. WHY A SEPARATE FILE IS REQUIRED: build-all.ts derives JP skill dates (resolveJpSkillDate, min-over-sources) from the GENERATED card/uma records, and that happens BEFORE the override loop runs — so dating an uma does NOT propagate to the skills it grants. Each skill below is dated to its granting uma's announced date. Scope was established by sweeping every server:'jp' skill carrying each uma's projected date, not by guessing at ids: that sweep is what surfaced the EVOLUTION-STAGE uniques (ids prefixed with the uma id, e.g. 102901111), which a name-based search alone would have missed. Every jp skill on those three dates is accounted for by these four umas — no unrelated record shares them. The base uniques (1xxxxx) and their inherited-unique twins (9xxxxx) were confirmed by name against uma.guide's skill listings; the uma-id-prefixed evolutions are self-identifying. NOTE: the five support cards in card_release_overrides.json need no companion entries here — all 15 skills on 30114, and every skill on the other four, already resolve to server:'global'.
